description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget (_ResultHaptics) that triggers a one-time haptic feedback (medium impact) when inserted into the widget tree. It manages safe execution using post-frame callbacks to avoid async context issues. The widget does not render any UI.

classes.name: _ResultHaptics
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that triggers a haptic feedback when added to the widget tree.

classes.name: _ResultHapticsState
classes.description: State class managing the lifecycle and effects of _ResultHaptics, executing the haptic feedback after the widget is built.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state and schedules the post-frame callback to trigger haptic feedback.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget, returning a transparent box (SizedBox.shrink()) with no visual output.
